overlaps.rationale: A motorcycle is powered by a motor; a bicycle is propelled by pedals.
The shared Indonesian word sepeda refers to different vehicles here: the bicycle is pedal-powered, while sepeda motor is powered by a motor.
A bus is a large passenger vehicle serving a route; the accepted car concept is a four-wheeled passenger vehicle.
A taxi is a car hired to carry passengers for a fare; the accepted car concept does not specify that service.
A truck carries goods; the accepted car concept describes a passenger vehicle.
A driver is a person; drive is the action of operating a car.
A driver is the person operating a road vehicle; a car is the vehicle.
A tire is a rubber covering on a vehicle wheel; a car is the whole vehicle.
A motorcycle helmet is protective headgear worn by a rider; a motorcycle is the vehicle.
A fuel station is a place to refuel vehicles; a car parking area is a place to park them.
A car parking area is a designated place to park cars; the accepted car concept is the vehicle itself.
A car parking area is designated for parking; a fuel station is for refueling.
